text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia (with neutropenia and lymphopenia), thrombocytopenia, elevated hematocrit, high ferritin, LDH, and INR, and mild elevation of basophils. These findings may indicate a severe inflammatory or infectious process (e.g., viral infection), possible bone marrow suppression, and risk of bleeding. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation are strongly recommended.
